topic: A used car's true cost per mile is usually higher than people assume once depreciation is counted, not just gas and insurance
title: Why Your 'Cheap' Used Car Is A Money Pit
description:
That 'great deal' on an older used car might be costing you thousands more than you think. It's not about the sticker price; it's about the hidden costs of depreciation and repairs that nobody calculates.

#personalfinance #usedcar #carbuying #depreciation #moneytips
